notes_for_editor: The only lookout fact is the October 1942 temporary cabin, quoted by Forest Lookouts from the Klamath NF chronology (Vol. V, 1941-1950), which I could not check directly. The agency fact is inferred from that chronology's title; no source names the agency for the lookout. County conflict, unresolved: the lookout listing says Del Norte County, while the USFS RNA page places Rock Creek Butte in westernmost Siskiyou County and gives 41.55, -123.633333 as its location (record point 41.53012, -123.66062). It is not certain they are the same place, so no correction is proposed; the editor may want to check the county. No source found on staffing after 1942, a permanent tower, or remains at the site. Brief record has no height, agency or status. A Rock Creek Butte in Baker County, Oregon is unrelated and was not used.
